queries.query: site:*.it ("casi studio" OR "progetti" OR "portfolio" OR "realizzazione sito" OR "ecommerce") (Veneto OR Lombardia OR Piemonte OR Emilia-Romagna OR Liguria OR "Friuli Venezia Giulia" OR Trentino OR Toscana) -linkedin -facebook
queries.objective: Identify concrete published digital projects that reveal the actual client/company and project scope.
queries.hypothesis: Agency and studio portfolio pages may name the requesting company and describe a complete web/ecommerce project with enough detail to infer need.
queries.missing: Named company, project type, and evidence of a complete digital initiative.
queries.expected_source: Agency portfolio pages, case studies, project pages on official domains.

queries.stop_condition: Stop if results are only agency self-promotion without client names or project specifics.
